name: A Mysterious Message
summary: In Westfall, a courier's intercepted message gives the People's Militia proof of who directs the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: Whispers of Blacknails
sections.body: The dispatch names VanCleef as the brotherhood's authority and mentions an associate called Blacknails. Its wider network remains hidden. By decoding the document, the People's Militia gains leverage over captured cutpurses and a way to find the brotherhood's true stronghold.

sections.title: Intercepted Orders
sections.body:
A Defias Messenger carries the message between Defias operations at Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry, and the Jangolode Mine. Its interception marks a break in Gryan Stoutmantle's investigation. For weeks, the People's Militia suspected someone directed the bandit uprising, but had no sure proof.

The missive confirms Edwin VanCleef commands the brotherhood's efforts across Westfall. He does so through coded ranks and intermediaries.

faq.q: What does this message reveal to the People's Militia?
faq.answer: The message gives Gryan Stoutmantle proof that Edwin VanCleef directs the Defias Brotherhood's operations across Westfall. It confirms the militia's suspicions about who commands the outlaws.

Blacknails is named in the intercepted text as an associate or agent. Little else is known of their identity or whereabouts, leaving them among the shadowy figures operating deep within the Defias network.
A Defias Messenger carries the message along Westfall's roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry, and the Jangolode Mine to coordinate bandit operations.

faq.q: What happens after Gryan Stoutmantle reads it?
faq.answer: With VanCleef's role confirmed, the militia turns to finding the Defias headquarters. A captured thief agrees to lead scouts to the secret hideout in exchange for his life.

angles.text: For Alliance champions helping in Westfall, the intercepted document proves the unrest in the kingdom's farmlands is a calculated insurgency led by Edwin VanCleef, not random banditry.
The intercepted dispatch gives rogues a glimpse of the operational security, courier paths, and coded communications used by the Defias underworld.
